# Tokeni Bar

> Tokeni Bar is a native macOS menu-bar app that shows verified AI coding
> usage and turns verified cumulative token growth into a local virtual-pet
> experience.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/90ms/tokeni-bar

## Current companion facts

- Growth is provider-neutral and derives only from verified cumulative token
  observations. Active minutes affect presentation, never growth.
- One Growth XP is awarded per 600,000 verified tokens. Sub-threshold token
  remainder carries across dates, while next-level UI normalizes each internal
  XP interval to 0–100 Growth Energy.
- The initial maximum is level 100 at 500 cumulative XP. Evolution is manual at
  levels 30 and 70 and does not spend XP.
- The menu popover shows a compact companion summary plus up to two distinct
  quota/reset summaries, or a token summary, for every enabled provider. A
  provider row deep-links to its Usage card.
- Companion management, collection, eggs, rewards, and cosmetics live under
  Pets. Provider, display, alert, usage, and privacy settings are integrated as
  the Settings destination in the same Tokeni window, using a vertical sub-menu.
- Levels 5, 10, 20, and 25 grant one-time boosters or cosmetics. Later level
  milestones grant Star Shards, and one timed booster can multiply only newly
  verified base Growth XP.
- Cosmetic slots are Aura, Background, Palette, Ground, Sidekick, Frame, and
  Scene. Legacy Body Color and Ground selections migrate to current items.
- The macOS menu popover has a session-only Caffeine toggle for preventing idle
  system sleep; display-sleep prevention is an optional persisted preference.
- Companion state never contains provider names, token totals, prompts,
  responses, or credentials.

## Source layout

- `Sources/TokeniCore`: provider-neutral models, scanners, adapters, and
  companion engines.
- `Sources/TokeniBar`: macOS menu-bar UI and app state.
- `Tests/TokeniCoreTests`: parser and core behavior tests with sanitized
  fixtures.
- `packaging`: app-bundle and Homebrew templates.
